method.unit: one row per district per Sentinel-1 pass (UTC day of acquisition)
method.observed_share: district land covered by the pass and not in the GFM exclusion mask / district land
method.flooded_share: GFM flood pixels / observed pixels (GFM removes normal permanent and monthly seasonal water)
method.advisory_share: observed pixels with a GFM advisory flag / observed pixels whose advisory flag is known (null when no advisory file exists for the pass)

label_rule.meaning: flood observed = observed_share >= 0.5 and flooded_share >= 0.10; passes that saw less than half the district are not labelled

skipped_scenes.reason: missing layer
